newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares close lower on correction.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares close lower on correction.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index closed slightly lower on Monday on a technical correction after continued rises over the past few trading days, brokers said.
The index fell 0.23 points or 0.15 percent to end at 150.73 points on turnover of HK$116 million, compared with HK$127 million on Friday.

The A share market extended gains into Monday with fewer worries about stability in China after Deng Xiaoping's death, brokers said. The A share index rose 3.41 points or 0.95 percent to 362.69 points on turnover of 6.51 billion yuan against Friday's 6.57 billion yuan.
"Most investors will stay on the sidelines in the next few days, waiting for market-moving news," an analyst with a major Chinese brokerage said.
"I would suggest investors have more cash in hand due to the market uncertainties," a broker said.
On the B share market, building materials producer Shenzhen Fangda Industrial Co Ltd was the worst performer, falling HK$0.55 or 5.84 percent to HK$8.86 on trade of 1.44 million shares.
Brokers said the counter fell on investor disappointment over the company's plan to issue a cash dividend of 0.15 yuan per share on its 1996 profits.
Fangda said on Monday its 1996 net profit soared 157 percent year-on-year to 107.26 million yuan under domestic accounting standards.
According to international accounting standards, Fangda's 1996 net profit was 107.9 million yuan.
Television producer Shenzhen Huafa Electronics Co Ltd, the second sharpest loser, fell HK$0.14 or 3.50 percent to HK$3.86 on volume of 138,500 shares.
Brokers blamed the falls on its pessimistic forecasts about its 1996 annual results.
China Southern Glass Holdings Co Ltd held steady at HK$4.92 on the session's heaviest volume of 2.27 million shares on institutional trading.

On the A share market, property concern Shenyang Fangtian Co Ltd was the top gainer, rising 0.65 yuan or 10 percent to close at 7.10 yuan on 10.65 million shares on institutional speculative buying, brokers said.
Shenzhen Fangda Industrial Co Ltd ended down 0.59 yuan at 15.59 yuan, making it the session's weakest performer.
